prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Delivery is a cheerful low-poly Chinese delivery game with toy yellow houses, grass, a yellow-helmet courier and bean-eyed elderly villagers. Create a clean in-game conversation UI concept, not a chat app. Warm ivory, charcoal and subtle yellow, crisp Chinese typography, softly rounded fine outlines and minimal shadow. Keep the scene unobstructed. The NPC woman has a small white head bubble saying 谁怕谁？让他过来！ and a small T key with 和翠花说话. Lower center above five inventory slots: compact cream strip, about 46 percent screen width and 100px tall at 1080p. Header 对翠花说 with close ×. Input placeholder 输入你想说的话 and dark button 发送 ↵. Below: 不知道说什么？看看例句. Player's last utterance in a thin dark translucent caption above: 你：大壮就在旁边，你俩到底谁更厉害？ No tall chat log, empty area, multicolour cards, decorative icons or desktop app appearance. Editable Unreal UMG layout, 16:9.
